method: Current committed Coloop tree plus Git-visible RK and rk-opencode working-tree source snapshots. Coloop source history is preserved as a merge parent. The previous complete remote main is retained on the history branch.
excludes: Local credentials and actual connection configuration
Model weights, SDK binaries and virtual environments
Generated builds, release executables, runtime data and logs
digest_scope: export_sha256 hashes the Git-index blob after .gitattributes normalization
